title: The ASES London bootcamp
subtitle: A ten-week programme for around seventy fellows, and the first environment I had to design rather than attend.
description: Zoe Zhou's case study on designing a ten-week entrepreneurship bootcamp for around seventy selected fellows with ASES London.

sections.heading: The question
sections.body:
I won the ASES London competition and a funded place at the Stanford Summit, and came back to co-lead the London chapter. Having been let into a room, the question was how to build one.

ASES London is the student chapter of a Stanford entrepreneurship society. It is separate from LSESU Entrepreneurs, where I spent two years on the executive; the two come up together on a CV and are not the same organisation.
sections.editorTodo: Optional: one paragraph on what London lacked that Stanford had, in your own words.
